metadata.name: Cell — FAR-FOOD + PILLARS, PRECISION-WEIGHTED ARBITRATION (round-3 lever, study brain)
metadata.description: ROUND-3 LEVER (2026-09-06): the study brain in the far-food + pillars world with the arbiter in scoring_mode 'precision' -- each loop's own bearing stream is coarse-grained by a per-loop EPM (reality.loop.<name>), a LateralVoter at level 1 grades them (trust 1/(tle+eps), informativeness-gated), and the arbiter selects by preference precision x trust instead of the efe value race (audit V6: the race's units let play win by construction). Wrong-sign control: EFEArbiter.precision_sign=-1. Compare against the_cell_route_far_pillars.json (efe). ROUND-2 BASE v2 (2026-09-06): the STUDY BRAIN (the_cell_arbiter_room_pillars_vision.json's 16 modules: RunTumbleNavV2 klino, PlaceGraphPlanner, PlayLoop, the inert vision loop at vision_weight 0, four HeadingControllers, EFEArbiter in efe mode, six-channel MotorBus; the planner's seven dead keys removed) in the far-food + pillars world at scent falloff 2.0. Replaces the_cell_route_far_pillars_v1klino.json, whose klino was RunTumbleNav v1. CALIBRATED 2026-09-06: scent_falloff_radius 2.0 (was 6.0). At 6.0 and 3.5 the reactive specialist returns to the relocated food in ~3000 ticks (3.7 eats / 240 s, n=6) because the screened-Poisson field never reaches zero; at 2.0 its return takes 4966 ticks against the gradient-blind floor's 5927 (3.0 vs 1.8 eats) while the first eat is still earned locally -- the setting where memory is demanded and the reflex is not. ROUND-2 BASE (2026-09-06). the_cell_route_far_baseline.json's world (24 m open arena, two food sites 16 m apart, scent falloff 6, alternating) plus pillars (obstacle_density 0.06, scent attenuation 0.3, obstacle_seed 1000; --vary-world redraws the layout per job). Without pillars the absolute-heading panorama is a constant vector and the place EPM holds 2 nodes for the whole run (audit V4/L9 liveness 2026-09-06); with them it holds ~10 in 120 s and play's route_exists holds on a third of samples. Brain: the four-loop study composition with the arbiter in efe mode. Liveness 2026-09-06: PASS except 'planner wins' -- the planner scores routes but never wins against play's saturating value (audit V6).
metadata._comment_forage: falloff 12->15 (2026-07-05 sweep): the reach fix for far-field quad foraging. At 12 the bug could not home across a 24m zone (first eat ~t13400, eat-gated reveal effectively dead); at 15 the first eat lands ~t1213 (11x faster) and the bug actually forages the revealed zones. 15 is the reach ceiling (>=16 flattens the screened-Poisson field -> no climbable gradient). Higher energy_drain, food-at-connector, and smaller room ALL tested WORSE. Honest limit: self-driven 4-zone completion is a capability limit (the bug reaches NE/NW but, full right after an eat, plays instead of foraging the far center food) -> the timed reveal (wall_drop_period) backstops hands-off completeness; the FIRST connector is eat-earned.
metadata._comment_scent: publish_scent_ring=false → the body virtualizes scent POSITION-ONLY (a scalar sampled at the bug's centre, frame-independent 'bath'). The directional 8-nostril ring (reality.proprio.scent) is a scaffold / different sensory modality and is fully bypassed here — nothing in this config consumes it (klino=RunTumbleNav is scalar run-and-tumble, direction emerges from motion). Defensible chemotaxis: no directional read of the source.
metadata._comment_quad: QUAD adaptability env: 2x2 spiral of 4 zones (SW->SE->NE->NW) of increasing complexity, isolated by a + cross with 3 DROPPABLE connectors. Bug boxed in Z1; connectors open on wall_drop_period ticks (headless) or KEY_D (UI). One fixed food per zone. Demonstrates the planner+confinement-steer discovering new zones as they open.
metadata._comment_respawn: quad_respawn_single: eat all 4 zone foods first (one-shot, clears the board), THEN respawn one food at a time at a random zone → the bug must re-find a single moving target across the revealed maze. Exercises the 3-loop division.

params._comment: LEARNED advance (genuine 'act on a heading') + wedge-escape safety net + explore-on-lost. Defensible action layer.
params._comment_hk: advance_homeokinetic: reward = max(0,vel_fwd) − effort·|vel_fwd| (food-DECOUPLED, intrinsic controllable motion). No cos(bearing) → off-axis forward not punished → off-axis forward is no longer punished into NEGATIVE; the table STILL flattens to ~0 when STUCK (reward 0 → EMA → 0) — the hunger-gated escape recovers it. nav+turn-priority handle aiming.

params._comment: learn_appearance: the bug LEARNS food's colour from real eats (events.eat = ground truth, NOT the overloaded events.hit); no hardcoded green. emit_proximity -> values[2]=green_frac (the reach/looming signal).
food-bearing EPM (angle-selective). Its TLE = VisualHomingNav's §1 predictive error; node_count = informativeness (degenerate occluded-only node -> low trust). Output reality.cognitive.vision.

QUICK KICK away from walls: HOLD steer-away for pulse_ticks (effective impulse), then refractory release so the cog resurfaces, drives, and LEARNS the turn. pulse_ticks + refractory_ticks are live HotMutable sliders — tune the kick feel to taste.
MISMATCH stuck: commands motion but doesn't achieve it (|afferent|<<|intended|). Self-normalizing, no velocity threshold. Turning/idle (intended~0) never fires. refractory 120.

Round 3: trust 1/(tle+eps) over the four loops' own bearing streams, informativeness-gated (the fusion testbed's setting); activity_gain 0 in the first form -- a committed straight route is steady, not frozen, and the activity term would punish it; the activity arm is separate.

L2 active-inference policy selection. scoring_mode='efe' (ACTIVE): each policy scored as an EXPECTED FREE ENERGY G = pragmatic (hunger×reach-prob) + epistemic ((1−hunger)×uncertainty-reduction). The two PRAGMATIC terms share units (hunger×reach-prob) so the klino/planner scale mismatch is gone BY CONSTRUCTION — no cede, no plan_peak self-norm, no max-of-three. klino reach-prob = its eat-calibrated capability (cap→1 in its own eating range); planner reach-prob = its DISCOUNTED route value (γ^hops<1 to a remembered cache) → near food g_prag_klino=hunger>hunger·γ^hops so klino OWNS THE CLOSE decisively. klino epistemic = the z-spike (scent rising = 'food this way', wins the approach); hunger sets the exploit↔explore balance (no tuned λ). vs value_race (the legacy asymmetric z-score/level race). winner-take-all with margin=hysteresis_k·running_std(G_klino−G_planner). Hard gains 1/0 → MotorBus arbiter.gain.<name>. Watch the four-term race + precision meters in the xaq_inspector EFEArbiter widget. force_policy ablations: ''=live / 'klino' / 'planner' / 'shuffle'. seed42 300s: efe 4 eats / hunger 0.19 vs value_race 2 eats / hunger 0.26 (efe hands the fast direct forager more authority when sated → breaks the planner-crawl starvation).
params._comment_play: task #33 Stage 2 QUAD: play LIVE (play_weight=1). After eating a zone's one-shot food the bug is sated + scent fades → klino/planner go quiet → play (energy-surplus·novelty) wins → run-tumble WANDER beyond the mapped frontier → discovers the connector / next zone (the confinement-steer couldn't). play_weight live slider: 0=2-loop control.
params._comment_vision: loop #4 Stage 1: vision_weight=0 (INERT) -> 3-policy race byte-identical + 4th channel published at 0 authority (consumer fires). Set 1 for Stage 2 (the scent-blind close).
params._comment_round3: scoring_mode precision: score_i = preference precision (hunger; play_weight x surplus for play) x the voter's trust in loop i's own bearing stream. precision_sign -1 = the wrong-sign control.

params._comment: proportional_mix = TURN-PRIORITY: cog passes linear below unity (gain 0.75 keeps it off the limiter → headroom for the steer differential + the whisker pulse, channels linked). The turn gets range first (can drive the opposite paddle negative = pivot → tight radius ~6.5 vs 8.8); forward yields. Fixes the wide-arc. cog gain is a live slider: ↑ = faster forward/wider, ↓ = tighter.
params._comment_tb: turn_brake=0 (2026-07-09 motor fix): the old turn_brake=3 turn-priority clamped forward to head=max(0,1-3|diff|) -> the body arced (tfrac->1, fwd~1 m/s), never turning-then-running; every klino variant hit this downstream wall. Removing it (keep proportional_mix) unblocks travel (fwd->3.85 m/s at 48m) and makes even the plain kinesis beat the random-walk floor across the room battery. A removal, not a magic number.
params._comment_arbiter: gain_mod_prefix wires planner→arbiter.gain.planner, klino→arbiter.gain.klino (whisker/stuck have no arbiter gain → default 1.0, safety layer never muted). effective_gain = base · arbiter → mix AND authority, so the muted loop gets 0 authority and its advance learning pauses. Base gains 0.75 → a 1.0 arbiter gain passes the loop under the limiter; a 0.0 mutes it cleanly.
